title: An Evidence-Driven Multi-Agent Compound AI System for Head and Neck Proton Radiotherapy Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29010v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Radiation treatment planning requires balancing competing objectives to satisfy clinical criteria while accommodating physicians' preferences. This study aims to develop an evidence-driven, multi-agent compound AI system that integrates DRL-based automated treatment planning with LLM-based conversational plan refinement for proton PBS therapy. A policy network trained using PPO first generates multiple plans without human intervention, from which one is selected as the target plan and the others serve as references for subsequent refinements. For challenging cases requiring further adjustments, an LLM-based multi-agent system enables plan refinement through natural language interactions. The system comprises a planning agent that recommends evidence-supported adjustments, a chatbot providing a unified conversational interface, and an evaluation agent that retrieves clinical metrics and identifies constraint violations. translated_title: 一种用于头颈部质子放射治疗计划的证据驱动多智能体复合AI系统
translated_abstract: 放射治疗计划需要在相互竞争的目标之间进行权衡，以在满足临床标准的同时兼顾医生的偏好。本研究旨在开发一种证据驱动的多智能体复合AI系统，该系统将基于深度强化学习（DRL）的自动化治疗计划与基于大语言模型（LLM）的对话式计划优化相结合，应用于质子笔形束扫描（PBS）治疗。首先，使用PPO训练的策略网络在无需人工干预的情况下生成多个治疗计划，从中选择一个作为目标计划，其余计划则作为后续优化的参考。对于需要进一步调整的复杂病例，基于LLM的多智能体系统可通过自然语言交互实现计划优化。该系统包括：推荐有证据支持的调整方案的规划智能体、提供统一对话界面的聊天机器人，以及获取临床指标并识别约束违例的评估智能体。为了增强领域……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了一种证据驱动的多智能体复合AI系统，将基于深度强化学习的自动化质子放射治疗计划与基于大语言模型的对话式计划优化相结合，可在满足临床指标的同时通过自然语言交互满足医生的个性化偏好。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an evidence-driven multi-agent compound AI system that integrates DRL-based automated treatment planning with LLM-based conversational plan refinement for head and neck proton radiotherapy, enabling natural-language-driven plan optimization that satisfies clinical criteria while accommodating physician preferences.
